BrochureContent.Content:
Gary O'Driscoll & Co. are proud to present Spa House, an impressive four-bedroom detached residence standing on around 3 acres of mature grounds in the highly sought-after Spa area of County Kerry. Occupying a private and idyllic setting, this distinguished home offers a rare opportunity to acquire a property of exceptional character, scale and potential in one of the county's most desirable residential locations.

Perfectly positioned, Spa House enjoys the tranquillity of country living while benefiting from the convenience of being within walking distance of all local amenities in Spa, just 5.2 km from the renowned Fenit Beach, and within easy reach of Tralee Town and its extensive range of services, schools and recreational amenities.

Extending over two floors, the residence offers generously proportioned accommodation throughout and retains many original features synonymous with homes of this era. While requiring refurbishment and modernisation, Spa House provides an outstanding opportunity for discerning purchasers to restore and enhance a residence of considerable charm and distinction, creating a truly exceptional family home.

The accommodation briefly comprises an entrance lobby and welcoming hallway, a magnificent lounge, a second reception room, formal dining room, office, spacious kitchen, guest WC and rear hall with stairwell. Upstairs, the property boasts four well-proportioned bedrooms, a main family bathroom, together with a substantial first-floor store room offering further versatility and potential.

The property benefits from oil-fired central heating, mains water supply and a septic tank located to the rear. Subject to the necessary planning permissions, there is excellent scope for further extension or reconfiguration, allowing prospective owners to maximise the full potential of this unique holding.

A particular highlight of the property is its beautiful cobblelock courtyard, which provides an elegant and private outdoor setting, ideal for entertaining or simply enjoying the peaceful surroundings. The mature grounds surrounding the residence are a notable feature, offering an abundance of space for landscaped gardens, recreational use, equestrian pursuits or future development potential, subject to the appropriate consents.

Set amidst approximately 2.8 acres of established grounds, Spa House enjoys a sense of privacy and seclusion rarely found, while its enviable location combines coastal living with everyday convenience. The picturesque village of Fenit, with its Blue Flag beach, marina and scenic coastal walks, lies just a short drive away, further enhancing the lifestyle appeal of this exceptional property.

Combining substantial accommodation, mature grounds, timeless character and remarkable potential, Spa House represents a truly unique opportunity to acquire a landmark residence in one of County Kerry's most prestigious and sought-after locations.

Viewing is highly recommended and strictly by appointment with sole selling agents Gary O'Driscoll & Co.
